description:
SGP is seeking an experienced Proposal Manager to support a dedicated engagement with an established federal contractor holding multiple certifications. You will lead proposals and task order responses across a diverse portfolio including IT and cybersecurity, telecommunications, physical security, audiovisual systems, program management, and federal construction supporting defense and civilian agencies. You’ll work closely with an established capture organization to develop compelling, compliant proposals.

You’ll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable collaborating with client leadership, business development, and technical teams while coordinating with SGP's broader consultant network. You'll also have a demonstrated ability to partner with capture managers and coordinators, proposal coordinators, writers, editors, graphic designers, and pricing and contracts professionals to deliver cohesive, competitive proposals.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $100 - $120 per hour.

Security Clearance: Active Security Clearance.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you'll enjoy the independence and flexibility of 1099 work while benefiting from the resources, collaboration, and professional support of an experienced capture and proposals team.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who bring diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead proposals and task order responses from kickoff through submission, incorporating capture strategies and win themes provided by the capture team.

  • Manage quick-turn task order responses under GSA MAS, OASIS+, and construction MATOC, MACC, and BPA vehicles, alongside larger competitive bids.

  • Manage IT and cybersecurity proposals, including operations and maintenance (O&M), cloud, services, software development, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), data analytics, and network and systems management requirements.

  • Manage construction and infrastructure proposals, including design-build, renovation, mechanical and electrical systems, telecommunications and fiber, physical security, and audiovisual systems.

  • Analyze solicitations and develop compliance matrices, annotated outlines, schedules, and storyboards.

  • Facilitate kickoff meetings, status calls, and color team reviews (Pink, Red, Gold).

  • Collaborate with SMEs, engineers, and estimators to develop technical approaches, staffing plans, and management volumes, and coordinate with pricing teams on cost volumes.

  • Maintain and leverage reusable proposal content, past performance information, and resumes to support high-volume response cycles.

  • Oversee final production, quality checks, and timely submission.

Required qualifications

  • At least five years of experience in federal proposal management.

  • Demonstrated experience managing proposals in at least two of the following areas: IT services and cybersecurity; telecommunications and infrastructure; physical security and audiovisual systems; or federal construction.

  • Experience managing task order responses under multiple-award IDIQs, BPAs, or GWACs.

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) and federal civilian customers.

  • Strong command of proposal best practices.

  • Excellent organizational, writing, and editing skills with the ability to meet tight deadlines.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience developing proposals or task order responses under GSA MAS, OASIS+, and construction contract vehicles used by USACE, NAVFAC, or NIH.

  • Familiarity with federal customers, including the Army, Navy, Air Force, USACE, DHS, Department of State, GSA, NIH, and Department of the Interior.

  • Experience developing proposals for 8(a), HUBZone, or other small business set-aside opportunities.

  • Familiarity with CMMI, ISO, or similar quality frameworks and their frameworks as proposal discriminators.

  • APMP Foundation-level, Practitioner, or Professional certification.

  • Active security clearance.
